name: brand-knowledge-base
description: Four specialists who turn facts scattered across a company into one brand knowledge base that AI can read, answer from and cite — a brand fact library, a differentiation ledger with evidence levels, and a set of citation-ready assets.

displayName.en: Brand Knowledge Base Team by Supro AI
displayName.zh: 数珀AI 提供的 品牌知识库搭建专家团

profession.zh: 品牌知识库搭建专家团

displayDescription.en: [Supro AI] Fixes the gap where AI describes your company with facts that are stale, scattered or simply wrong. Builds one brand knowledge base AI can read, answer from and cite.
displayDescription.zh: 【数珀AI】AI 里问起你们公司，信息又旧又散、还把竞品混进来？梳理品牌事实与差异，搭建一份 AI 读得懂、答得出、可引用的品牌知识库。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: AI 里问起我们公司，说出来的信息又旧又散，还把竞品和我们混在一起——帮我搭一份完整的品牌知识库
defaultInitPrompt.en: Ask AI about our company and the facts are stale, scattered, or mixed up with competitors. Build us a complete brand knowledge base.

quickPrompts.en: Ask AI about our company and the facts are stale, scattered, or mixed up with competitors. Build us a complete brand knowledge base.
quickPrompts.zh: AI 里问起我们公司，说出来的信息又旧又散，还把竞品和我们混在一起——帮我搭一份完整的品牌知识库

quickPrompts.en: AI never mentions what we are actually best at, and the pitch our sales team uses never makes it onto the website. Turn our differentiation into a defensible, publishable list.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们最拿手的那块能力 AI 从来没提过，销售嘴里那套也写不进官网——帮我把差异化能力梳成一份能对外说、有证据的清单

quickPrompts.en: We want one version of the truth inside the company before feeding it to AI and customers. Organise the material scattered across departments into a structured knowledge base that people and AI can both use.
quickPrompts.zh: 想让内部口径先统一，再喂给 AI 和客户——帮我把散在各部门的品牌资料整理成一份结构化的知识库，人和 AI 都能直接用
